messages:
arya: Starting tonight's handoff — I'm on from 18:00-02:00 UTC. Main watchlist items, non-incident: 
• KV prefix cache sporadic spikes on app-cache-prod (latency + token churn). Seen after a couple fast rollouts. Dashboards: <https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/kv-cache>. 
• embedding-worker OOMs on small batches (worker-3 group) — causes retries and alert flapping. 
• noisy alert group: query latencies p95 alerts firing repeatedly for short bursts (alert: latency-p95-noisy). 
Please monitor these, and I'll be reachable on pings.

oncall-bot: Handoff created for arya — scheduled 18:00-02:00 UTC; handoff id HND-1769998888.

sam: I'll watch embedding workers from 20:00-00:00 in case it spikes. If you see OOMs, quick fix: `kubectl delete pod -l app=embedding-worker -n prod` then scale back to desiredReplica=3. Also check memory bump in the last deploy.

kevin: KV spikes look like the TTL leak we've seen before. Query to check expirations: `sum(rate(kv_cache_items_expired_total[5m])) by (shard)` and `sum(rate(kv_cache_items_set_total[5m]))` — if expirations >> sets, likely leaking keys with short TTLs.

marta: FYI I muted the noisy-p95 alert group at 19:15 UTC for 30m to reduce pager noise while we triage. Keeping watch; I'll unmute earlier if things stabilize. :alarm_clock:

arya: noted, thanks. Also keep an eye on redis read timeouts — saw several `i/o timeout` traces last night that correlated with higher KV latency. Runbook: <https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache>. If sustained errors, page infra-sre.

sam: quick heads-up on CR #4567 (embedding batching tuning). If merged, it will trigger a rollout that can transiently increase memory for a minute. I can block the merge if team wants to wait until after 22:00. @kevin — any rollback notes?

kevin: Rollback plan for cache-service if rollout causes KV churn: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/cache-service -n prod --to-revision=2` then scale replicas to stable count. Also have snapshots of primary metrics at 18:00 to compare.

marta: I'm available to swap with arya 22:00-02:00 if needed. Otherwise I'll be on standby for paging. :thumbsup:

arya: thanks — leaving a short note in the handoff doc with the watchlist and links: <https://docs.redwood/hand-offs/1769998888>. If you see alert storm, post the first 3 log lines and the grafana panel screenshot here.

kevin: quick diagnostic snippet if someone needs it: 
```
# check expired keys rate
curl -s 'http://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(kv_cache_items_expired_total[5m]))' | jq .data
```

sam: also pinging @marta on the embedding worker OOMs — if we start seeing >3 restarts in 5m, escalate to infra-sre. I'll post a short checklist in the doc.

oncall-bot: Reminder: auto-check scheduled at 00:00 UTC — will run health ping and post summary in #eng-oncall.

arya: wrap-up: primary risks = TTL leak causing KV churn, embedding worker OOM flapping, noisy p95 alerts. Coverage: sam 20:00-00:00, marta 22:00-02:00 swap available. I will escalate to infra-sre on sustained errors. Good luck everyone.
